page.layout: One printed page, blank. Only handwriting in pencil or ink at the lower right, upside down, and a brown stain at the top and right; no printed text.
page.notes: The page is blank apart from a manuscript inscription at the lower right, written upside down and not printed, so it is left out of the transcription. Brown stains at the top centre and upper right are not text. The inscription is unreadable to me and is not transcribed.
